report:
debezium-cassandra connector error

I installed debezium 2.4, cassandra 3.11.9 and kafka latest with dockerize.
My cassandra table:
cqlsh> desc test.foo;

     b text
) WITH bloom_filter_fp_chance = 0.01

     AND cdc = true

I created the "debezium-connector-cassandra" file in the /kafka/connect directory and created the "debezium-cassandra-connector.properties" file inside.

offset.backing.store.dir=/debezium-connector-cassandra/test_dir/

Then I ran the following command.
  java -jar /kafka/connect/debezium-connector-cassandra/debezium-connector-cassandra-1.1.1.Final-jar-with-dependencies.jar /kafka/connect/debezium-connector-cassandra/debezium-cassandra-connector. properties > debezium.stdout.log 2> debezium.stderr.log

evidence.quote: Damn I see it now, you have cassandra.config=cassandra.config=... so you are duplicating the parameter name in the option

notes: Property value duplicated its own key, producing a bogus cassandra.yaml path; Cassandra config loader error looks like a connector path-handling bug. Reporter did not confirm.
